description: Shows whether this account has a GitHub repo connected, or lists files under a path in that repo. If not connected, the result includes installUrl — open it (GitHub App) to grant read access to one repo. Sign in on botkelp.com with GitHub first so the install is tied to your account.

path.description: Folder or file in the connected repo to list. Omit for connection status.

name: get_github
title: Get GitHub connection
